about: Nicolás's evaluation set (php artisan assistant:eval). Each case is asked through the same code students use; a version reaches students only when the score reaches assistant.eval.min_score, every critical case passes and every model of the cascade answered its own cases (the set has at least one case that enters at each: «definicion-al-pequeno», «viabilidad», «analisis-a-fondo»). Who asks: full, modules:1,2, admin, and a province by its INE code after @ (full@28). Checks: status, route (the model of the cascade that answered: small, medium, large), any (at least one of these words), none, none_regex, cites (sources given), tool (a tool used), language, sources_within (only pieces of the modules owned). Every case is also checked for leaks (the canary, a key). Add a case for each mistake found in the traces: docs/asistente-ia.md.
